title: 8th Annual Gardens Aglow
seo_title: 8th Annual Gardens Aglow in Springfield, MO – Nov 29
description: The 8th Annual Gardens Aglow takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026 at 5:00 PM at Mizumoto Japanese Stroll Garden, 2400 S Scenic in Springfield, Missouri. This outdoor event is open to a general audience.
